title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Tracks measured startup, repository switching, tree transport, review-run latency, rendering, and long-session memory. QS-82 implements the lazy tree transport slice and integrates QS-78 snapshot restoration without duplicating QS-54 cache work; re-measured on 2026-08-24 against origin/main e31089c and independently reproduced on the committed tree b36bfe3 the same day. Reconciled on 2026-08-28 with QS-86, replayed and fully re-gated on 2026-09-01 against origin/main 7d3abdf, then rebased on 2026-09-07 onto origin/main 6b4e7b3, which had landed the frontend service split, a bounded dashboard LRU, a Git-fingerprint TTL, and derived function units. Eleven conflicts were resolved onto main's newer structure with no feature reworked; build, dotnet format, 547 .NET tests, 144 Angular tests, lint, production build, and the 13-point tree-v2 contract are green.
